import pandas as pd

# Load intermediate join results
step1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_36/intermediate_step1.csv")
step2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_36/intermediate_step2.csv")
step3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_36/intermediate_step3.csv")
step4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_36/intermediate_step4.csv")

# Drop 'Unnamed: 0' from step1 as it is an index column from CSV saving
step1 = step1.drop(columns=['Unnamed: 0'])

# Merge all intermediate steps on 'Id'
# step1 has ['Id', 'SalePrice_x', 'SalePrice_y']
# step2 has ['Id', 'SalePrice_x_3', 'SalePrice_y_4']
# step3 has ['Id', 'SalePrice_x_5', 'SalePrice_y_6']
# step4 has ['Id', 'SalePrice_x_7', 'SalePrice_y_8']

df = step1.merge(step2, on='Id', how='inner') \
          .merge(step3, on='Id', how='inner') \
          .merge(step4, on='Id', how='inner')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df = df[['Id', 'SalePrice_x', 'SalePrice_y', 'SalePrice_x_3', 'SalePrice_y_4',
         'SalePrice_x_5', 'SalePrice_y_6', 'SalePrice_x_7', 'SalePrice_y_8']]

# Ensure correct dtypes
df = df.astype({
    'Id': 'int64',
    'SalePrice_x': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_y': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_x_3': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_y_4': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_x_5': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_y_6': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_x_7': 'float64',
    'SalePrice_y_8': 'float64'
})

# Save final target table
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
